title: Zoning text change for affordable housing, Sapphire Street, Queens
summary: This application establishes a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 135-27 Sapphire Street in Queens Community District 10, working alongside a related rezoning from R4 to R6A. Together the actions would allow a new six-story residential building with about 186,380 square feet of floor area and roughly 268 units, of which about 67 would be permanently income-restricted. The City Council approved the measure on October 22, 2026.
